milestoneContract.title: V6 PKG-D standalone launcher provider provenance
milestoneContract.objective: Let the canonical Claude builder and Codex reviewer brokers run with verified standalone launchers while keeping FULL_PACKAGE unchanged, using only Founder-authorized minimum changes.
requirements: [V6-PKG-D-STANDALONE-LAUNCHER-PROVENANCE-2026-09-26 founderAuthorization.rule] Add provenance level STANDALONE_LAUNCHER to capture-provider-provenance and the brokers. It is accepted only when launcher path, version and SHA-256 are verified together, and the SHA is rechecked on every broker call. FULL_PACKAGE stays unchanged for npm package installs.

[V6-PKG-D-STANDALONE-LAUNCHER-PROVENANCE-2026-09-26 founderAuthorization.constraint] Minimum changes only; no weakening of trust, authority, reviewer isolation, evidence, provenance, Global Stop, security or fail-closed behavior; broader protected changes require separate Founder approval.
acceptanceCriteria: Canonical validation (config/validation.json) passes on the exact reviewed commit on Windows with Node >=24 and npm >=11.

capture-provider-provenance records STANDALONE_LAUNCHER only for a regular-file launcher whose --version exits 0 and whose whole stdout matches the tool pattern, records its SHA-256, and otherwise keeps LAUNCHER_ONLY with final BLOCKED.

Both brokers accept only FULL_PACKAGE or STANDALONE_LAUNCHER, recheck the launcher SHA-256 on every call, keep the package.json check for FULL_PACKAGE, and re-verify the exact standalone version on every call before spawning the model.
The non-protected provider selftest keeps all previous checks and replaces only the old FULL_PACKAGE-only text check with checks for the authorized rule.
Only the Founder-authorized protected files change, and no existing test assertion, validator or policy is weakened beyond the authorized rule.
Canonical validation (config/validation.json) passes on the exact reviewed commit on Windows with Node >=24 and npm >=11.
